message: I was chatting with my family in our group chat the other day, and we started sharing our favorite tips for staying safe on the road. It’s so helpful to have resources that prepare us for all sorts of travel situations. 🚗 One thing we all agreed on is that knowing what to do in a pinch can make a world of difference. I love how our family supports each other in being ready for anything—what’s your go-to travel tip?
